MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 43
   C. 49
   D. 41

2. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

3. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

4. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

6. Solve for x: x + 9 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 9
   D. 10

7. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 28
   C. 29
   D. 11

8. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 122

10. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 40
   C. 41
   D. 3

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

12. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 49

13. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 26

14. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 0

15. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 36
   C. 37
   D. 13

16. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 18

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
